title: Large personal Amiga/ST/DOS adventure and document recovery discovery
summary: Personally screen 768 candidate URLs and add 17 projects, with seven explicit non-promotion decisions.
notes: Root personally searched 12 GitHub query routes, screened 768 unique URLs and inspected 24 pinned repository trees. Seventeen additions and seven explicit non-promotions. Partial native routine recovery is distinguished from reference CPU runtime; original source platform, data-format recovery, new remakes and semantic fidelity versus matching encodings are explicit. No upstream game, compiler, installer, emulator, mailer, hardware or network service was executed.

sources.reason: Function-level translation of decompiled AVATAR.EXE/TITLE.EXE C, with structured spells and original rule tables inspected.
Reconstructs v1/v2 DOS adventure interpreters, compiler and packer. Inspected original command-table opcodes, argument dereferencing and version-specific instruction limits.
Partial native math/video/audio routine recovery plus independent model/resource viewer. Inspected actual original-address-cited fixed-point projection geometry.
Ports original 68000 rules/tables/formats into structured Java records; inspected 16-byte enemy fields and original comparison constants. jMonkeyEngine replaces original cell renderer.
Handwritten player/control/collision routines follow original 68020 assembly, sharing big-endian memory and register-like temporary conventions. Inspected named Player functions and field offsets.
Render-free C engine/raylib shell reconstructs original game rules and original-data packs. Inspected structured combat powers and actor/resource ownership.
Shared retail/alternate source tree with 27 C/eight ASM units, real ownership labels and preserved original record data. Inspected substantive gameplay translation.
Routine-by-routine MASM flight/renderer/mission source translation; inspected fixed-width main-loop arithmetic and source-label mapping.
Native parser/renderer/editor implements historical node, navigation and formatting semantics. Inspected source-aware command parsing rather than emulator dependence.
Original author restores early 1990s Amiga 500 language/compiler/server sources; inspected parser action implementation and explicit build status.
Offline decoder reads events and per-occurrence Arrange mute fields with structural warnings. Inspected stored-pointer table and original timing/event parser.
Native program/accessory reconstructs HDOC headers, variable index records, LH5 nodes and help-link behavior. Inspected bounds-checked hypfile parser.
Converts original big-endian 3D2 objects, vertices and faces to binary STL. Inspected bounded header/geometry reader and mesh structures.
Original 1987–2001 mailer source with The-Box lineage; inspected substantial EMSI implementation and historical platform configuration.
Current Go successor implements original DOS data/save semantics and documented behavioral comparisons. Inspected structured original-save conversion and 39-topic facts index.
Native rule systems from original decompilation; inspected structured movement/path/cache code. Upstream end-to-end independence campaigns and scoped idle-save goldens retained.
Native Android recreation reads original SSI SHP sprite archives and equipment/scenario data; inspected offset/palette/sprite cache parser.

Playable product is static x86 recompilation; inspected native procedure retains CPU flags/register operations and precise instruction accounting. Useful partial BASIC analysis, but not yet independent semantic game replacement.
Explicitly new Amiga image editor with nothing reverse-engineered, not a historical application restoration for this pass.
Original Macintosh 68k code runs against Amiga service implementations. Native target is Amiga but source is Macintosh and gameplay source not reconstructed.
Macintosh Color VETTE original 68000 code plus Amiga compatibility layer. Amiga host alone does not establish recovered Amiga game source.
Original-level Tower of Babel remake, but reviewed evidence does not establish original executable/source-derived algorithm recovery. Keep remake lead, not silently call decompilation.
Default branch is migration notice to Go UltimaVRedux, promoted in this batch. Historical C# retained on legacy-csharp, not a separate current source recovery verified here.
Printer/hardware protocol emulation for MiSTer, not a specific recovered Amiga/ST/CPC/DOS application. Printing classic software output does not recover that software.
